description: This PHP class 'LDAPUserCollection' is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for managing collections of LDAP user data, including LDAP users, duplicate usernames, users associated with duplicate usernames, and failed users. It provides methods to access these data elements and count duplicates.

classes.name: LDAPUserCollection
classes.description: Represents a collection of LDAP users, including mechanisms to retrieve users, duplicate information, and failed user data.

methods.name: getLDAPUsers
methods.description: Returns the array of LDAPUser objects keyed by username.

methods.name: getDuplicateUsernames
methods.description: Returns an array of duplicate usernames.

methods.name: getUsersOfDuplicateUsernames
methods.description: Returns an array mapping usernames to arrays of LDAPUser objects.

methods.name: getDuplicateUserCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total count of duplicate LDAP users.

methods.name: getFailedUsers
methods.description: Returns an array of failed user distinguished names (DNs).
